name: AI Generator
author: story321

sections.description:
AI Generator is a revolutionary WordPress plugin that brings the power of artificial intelligence directly into your Gutenberg editor. Easily generate beautiful, responsive UI components using Tailwind CSS and standard HTML block comments.

Key Features:

  • 🤖 AI-powered UI component generation
  • 🎨 Tailwind CSS integration for modern, responsive designs
  • 📝 Seamless Gutenberg block editor integration
  • ⚡ Fast and intuitive sidebar interface
  • 🔧 Customizable prompts for precise control
  • 📱 Mobile-responsive designs out of the box

Third-Party Service Integration ⚠️

IMPORTANT: This plugin relies on the AI Generator third-party service to process your prompts and generate UI code.

  • Service URL: https://www.wpthemoon.com
  • Data Sent: When you use the generation feature, the plugin sends your text prompt and the current Gutenberg editor content (if applicable) to our API to generate the requested design.
  • Terms of Service: https://www.wpthemoon.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.wpthemoon.com/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy of AI Generator. An API Key is required to use the generation features.

No API Key? Sign up for free at wpthemoon.com to get started.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New
  3. Search for “AI Generator”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Settings -> AI Generator and enter your API Key
  6. Start generating UI components in the block editor!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-generator directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  4. Navigate to Settings -> AI Generator and enter your API Key
  5. Open any post or page and use the AI Generator sidebar in the block editor to generate UI elements

Getting Your API Key

  1. Visit https://www.wpthemoon.com
  2. Create a free account
  3. Navigate to your account dashboard
  4. Copy your API Key
  5. Paste it in Settings -> AI Generator in your WordPress admin
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need to create an account at https://www.wpthemoon.com to obtain an API Key. We offer a free tier to get you started.

Is my data safe?

We only transmit the prompt and the specific block context you are working on to our API for the sole purpose of generating the requested design. We do not store your content permanently. Please review our Privacy Policy at https://www.wpthemoon.com/privacy-policy for more details.

What data is sent to the third-party service?

When you generate UI components, we send:
– Your text prompt
– The current block context (if applicable)
– Your API key for authentication

We do NOT send your entire site content or any other personal data.

Does this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes! The plugin generates standard HTML and Tailwind CSS that works with any WordPress theme. However, your theme must support Tailwind CSS or you’ll need to enqueue the Tailwind CSS library.

Can I use this plugin offline?

No, the plugin requires an internet connection to communicate with our AI service for generating UI components.

What happens if I exceed my API limits?

Depending on your plan, you may receive an error message. You can upgrade your plan at https://www.wpthemoon.com to increase your limits.

Is there a limit to how many components I can generate?

This depends on your subscription plan. Free accounts have usage limits, while paid plans offer higher or unlimited generations.
